newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan and Turkey discuss military cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Jordan and Turkey discuss military cooperation.

text.p: Jordanian and Turkish airforce commanders held talks on Thursday to promote defence cooperation, the official state news agency said.

Petra state news agency said King Hussein and Crown Prince Hassan also met the Turkish airforce chief who had held talks earlier with senior Jordanian officials on ways of promoting cooperation between the two airforces.
The visit of the senior Turkish defence official to Amman was ahead of a visit next Monday by Turkish Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller, already postponed twice before.

Jordan is one of the few Arab countries that has not criticised a proposed Turkish security zone against Turkish Kurd rebels forces in northern Iraq. The buffer plan was announced in September but has not yet been put into force.
